objective: Turn the human-approved Pulling Season gameplay checkpoint into one authored production encounter. Fan out specialized direction and criticism, approve a whole-screen target before asset work, integrate through one protected Unity owner, preserve accepted gameplay through every repair, and require fresh trusted engine evidence before acceptance. Seek a high professional craft bar while remaining original and honest about what one bounded slice can prove.

nodes.instructions: The project runner launches this phase only after its first-playable dependency has a durable evidence-bound human promotion. Do not re-litigate that promotion or accept a prompt assertion in its place. Inspect the current accepted Unity revision and GameSpec revision 2, record the source revision and gameplay invariants production must preserve, and identify the exact fresh regression evidence the downstream Unity lane must produce. Fail closed if the workspace does not contain a playable accepted slice.

Develop three original whole-screen directions at the accepted shipping camera, then recommend one. Use the user's reference only as a high-level craft and mood bar; do not copy protected characters, props, layouts, branding, or assets. For each direction define composition, focal hierarchy, palette, material language, scale, crop silhouette, soil readability, hands, lighting, interface restraint, motion, sound mood, and production cost. State what would make the direction fail during play.

Propose a bounded environment, terrain, material, lighting, atmosphere, and color-script method that makes crop readiness, soil resistance, hand contact, and extraction readable at gameplay scale. Include Unity feasibility, reuse, performance, and accessibility failure modes.

Propose an original production method for the hero crop, roots, foliage, soil contact, damage, extraction, and persistent result. Specify required state variants and motion-friendly separation. Optimize for silhouette, tactile response, and authored specificity rather than asset count. Include provenance and import constraints.

Design the state-linked hands, camera, crop, soil, particles, haptics-ready cues, and audio choreography for approach, inspect, commit, grip, strain, slip, correct, extract, handle, acknowledge, and continue. Every flourish must communicate a gameplay decision or consequence. Specify timing beats and transition ownership.

Define the smallest production interface and accessibility layer. Prefer staging, animation, audio, and contextual prompts over prose. Cover reticle/contact affordance, readiness and resistance cues, tension communication, result language, input remapping assumptions, reduced camera motion, contrast, text scale, and prompt dismissal. Set an explicit on-screen text budget.

Synthesize one coherent target rather than combining every suggestion. Create target specifications for at least approach, active-pull, damaged-result, intact-result, and next-decision states at the shipping camera, plus a production component map and provenance plan. Targets must keep all interactive elements independently implementable and must not pretend concept imagery is engine evidence. Record exact omissions, performance assumptions, comparison dimensions, and the accepted gameplay invariants that cannot change.

Harshly review the target set as whole screens and as a state sequence. Score 0-100 for authored_specificity, focal_hierarchy, gameplay_readability, material_depth, state_differentiation, composition, interface_restraint, motion_plan, feasibility, and originality. Reject isolated asset moodboards, contradictory states, excessive text, hidden causality, copied protected content, or a target that cannot be decomposed into runtime consumers. On pass, emit the approved target artifact hash as projectEvidence.targetSha256.

Own production integration for the approved target hash. Build and integrate the required environment-lighting-materials, crop-soil-props, hands-camera-motion, effects-audio, and interface-accessibility families as real Unity runtime consumers. Use engine-native assets or available generation tools only where they improve the target; preserve prompts, licenses, provenance, source files, import settings, semantic state variants, and consumer paths. Preserve the accepted gameplay revision and immutable scenarios. Run Unity compile/import checks and leave the encounter playable. Do not replace the world with a flat image, hide failures with UI, or touch bridge/contracts/manifests.

Refresh compiler/import health, trusted v3 shipping-input traces, no-input counterfactuals, continuous high-resolution engine captures, motion sequences, audio-event evidence, approved-target binding, candidate fingerprint, and runtime asset consumer/provenance manifests. Fail closed on stale evidence, log errors, broken gameplay invariants, missing runtime consumers, or candidate-owned evidence producers.

Compare the current trusted production evidence with the accepted gameplay checkpoint. Reject any regression in controls, causality, correction, timing stakes, outcome attribution, recovery, or continuation. Distinguish a production defect from a product-level gameplay invalidation; never silently redefine the accepted loop.

Inspect real engine captures at gameplay scale. Score 0-100 for environment_authorship, lighting, material_separation, depth, crop_focal_hierarchy, soil_readability, composition, and performance_consistency. Compare against the approved target hash, not source files or concept images. Return evidence-linked blockers only.

Inspect the complete motion sequence and audio-event evidence. Score 0-100 for hand_contact, crop_deformation, soil_response, camera_feel, anticipation, strain, slip_and_recovery, extraction_impact, result_handling, effects_sync, and audio_sync. Reject decorative motion that is not state-linked or a polished crop that still feels like a progress bar.

Inspect every captured state for prompt overload, overlap, scaling, hierarchy, input clarity, contrast, reduced-motion implications, and whether the world carries meaning before text does. Enforce the approved text budget. Score 0-100 for first_glance_orientation, affordance, hierarchy, legibility, restraint, and accessibility.

Review the trusted production frames and embodied trace against the approved target and a high professional craft bar. Be harsh about coherence, authored specificity, tactile action, state readability, composition, motion continuity, and obvious placeholder residue. If approved local reference captures are present, compare anonymized crops side by side on declared dimensions without identifying brands or copying assets; otherwise explicitly mark external_reference_comparison as not_scored. Never call the game fun from media alone.

Arbitrate all reviews into one revision decision. Gameplay regression is a hard gate. Pass only when fresh trusted evidence binds the current fingerprint to the approved target, every required runtime asset family has a real consumer and provenance, the encounter reads coherently through motion, and no blocker or major production defect remains within the bounded slice. On revise, issue one prioritized brief with at most four changes and the exact evidence to refresh. Do not discard the accepted gameplay checkpoint; if evidence shows the product thesis itself is invalid, return a spec-amendment request instead of masking it with polish. Human approval remains required after pass.
